items.title: The projection formula map is an isomorphism for a morphism of ringed spaces that is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on the projection formula
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the projection formula comparison map is always an isomorphism when f : X -> Y is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset. The proof exploits exactness of f_* in this situation so that Rf_* is computed by any representative complex, represents the two sides using a K-flat complex K^bullet and an arbitrary complex E^bullet, and reduces the comparison to the identity f_*(E tensor f^*K) = f_*E tensor K for single modules (proof lines 13953-13977). The final step is a stalkwise check that splits into points outside f(X), where both sides vanish, and points in the image, where the tensor identity over local rings is verified (proof lines 13979-13989). H2: the reduction to single modules and the two-case stalk computation are the substance.
